saw_lines: Home decor is bought one corner at a time, and shoppers return for the next corner.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, where a shopper decides if the piece fits their room.
Your 13 copy ads carry 0 proof numbers, so add one review count or orders shipped and lead the next three ads with it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 14 Oct 2026
points: 0 of 13 copy ads carry a proof number, so a stranger has nothing to check before they click. Pick one number, like a review count or orders shipped, and open three of the next ads with it.
17 of 30 ads are catalog feed ads with no story, so the feed shows products without a reason to stop. Add three story ads, each opening on a real room problem like a hard chair or bare wall.

13 Shop now ads send buyers to the homepage instead of the item shown. A click on a specific product expects that product, so each detour costs a sale. Point every ad at the exact product or collection it shows.
0 of 13 copy ads carry an offer, so a new buyer has no reason to act today. Put one offer in line one of three new ads, such as a first order discount or a bundle of two pieces.
